I got two or three chapters in after the purchase and the author started a new chapter with a note that this is a new story starting, a spinoff of two of the original characters and that finishes the book. The original story just stops right in the middle with no ending. I’d love a refund, doubt that will happen. Total scam making you think you get the full story and you have to purchase for it. title: Lets address false advertisement
body: I downloaded because I saw an ad with one of the stories and it piqued my interest. I started reading the story and ran out of coins. You can either buy coins OR there is a subscription package that promotes "unlimited reading" . I got the weekly package while there was a deal (should've been the Red flag). What it DOESNT specify is that they SELECTED the books you can read unlimited. If you want to read something OUTSIDE of the selected books then you have to buy coins. The false advertisement for the subscription package is a S.C.A.M . There are more legitimate story apps that don't have to lie to get money or customers. This app is literally false advertisement at its best. There is no reason why someone would have to complain in a review to get a full detailed list of what they ALREADY paid for. It SHOULD BE UPFRONT.

title: My personal opinion
body: There are really good books on this app, js minor problems that build up. For instance you have to pay for every chapter not every other chapter. A solution for that is they give you a free chapter every hour. Thats where the problem begins. The free chapter is great but I don’t like the fact that the deeper you get in the book, the higher it cost to unlock. Then once you get so far the free chapters stop so you rely on the ads but you only get like 4/5 chapters. The free tickets help but with the chapters going up by 5s it gets really hard to enjoy the book you’re reading. My suggestion would be to just have all the chapters cost the same amount from the beginning, because it don’t seem worth it once you realize it just keeps getting more expensive. Taking away the free chapters every hour isn’t terrible, because you can rely on the ads but at least take off the limit of ads.

title: Misleading
body: I have a few complaints here and there. But overall the app has been working well. My biggest problem is that I paid for 2 memberships, assuming that one was a one-time payment. I’ve been trying to cancel but it’s nowhere on any of my settings. It clearly states that I can cancel whenever, but there isn’t anywhere on the app or my device settings that lets me. Even when I clicked delete account I still got charged. When I reached out to their support email over a week ago, they still haven’t replied. If you download this I highly recommend not paying for the memberships as the benefits are not worth the hassle.

I don’t want to pay for a subscription when the app doesn’t work, and it the long run that would cost me a ton for a single book.

title: Read Before Downloading
body: 5 stars so it will be seen.I loved this app at first. I was reading “You Rejected a Silver Wolf” and loving the story. Until I got to chapter 108. Now there are no more free chapters and you have to become a member to read more. Like a lot of us, I’m not able to pay to read books when I could spend that money on something I need. If you can afford it, just do it from the beginning. Otherwise, don’t waste your time reading half a book. Libraries are still open and lending books for free, or you could start a community book swapping club. Meanwhile, I’ll be deleting this app and picking up a good book from my collection.
